policy: Freeze these five fact clusters per candidate for historical significance before running fresh event-window calculations. Timestamp anchors must come from public evidence, never optimized on prices. Failed candidates stay failed; do not replace weak cards after seeing movements. Raw histories and broad daily-median suitability statistics were examined before this freeze; no new five-card event-window calculations have run. Prior project records contain measured responses for some reused Trump/Eagles events and Oscars 2026; those were visible while satisfying the required repository review. This is a prospective freeze of this research selection, not a claim of blinded preregistration.

finalists.workingTitle: The team that stopped the three-peat

events.title: Eagles lose 22–21 after Atlanta’s late touchdown
events.selectionReason: Early contender doubt and a notorious dropped pass.

events.title: Saquon Barkley rushes for an Eagles-record 255 yards
events.selectionReason: Famous new signing becomes the season’s star.

events.title: Hurts leaves with a concussion as Washington ends the Eagles’ winning streak
events.selectionReason: Quarterback health and seeding danger in one inseparable episode.

events.title: Eagles survive the Rams in the snow, 28–22
events.selectionReason: Memorable snow game, explosive runs and a late defensive escape.

events.title: Eagles score 55 to reach the Super Bowl
events.selectionReason: Conference breakthrough, leaving the ultimate championship unresolved.

events.title: Trump wins the presidency after campaigning to save TikTok
events.selectionReason: A new political escape route for a household-name app.

events.title: Appeals court rejects TikTok’s challenge to the divest-or-ban law
events.selectionReason: Major legal defeat.

events.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear TikTok’s challenge
events.selectionReason: An institutional lifeline, without a stay or merits victory.

events.title: Trump asks the Supreme Court to pause the TikTok deadline
events.selectionReason: The incoming president intervenes directly.

events.title: TikTok and the government face Supreme Court questioning
events.selectionReason: Public test of the rival free-speech and national-security arguments.

events.title: Anora leaves the Golden Globes empty-handed
events.selectionReason: The presumed contender misses all five prizes.

events.title: Anora earns six Oscar nominations; Emilia Pérez leads with 13
events.selectionReason: Nomination strength against a formidable rival.

events.title: Anora wins Critics Choice, Directors Guild and Producers Guild prizes in one weekend
events.selectionReason: One clustered comeback, not three cards measuring the same news.

events.title: Conclave wins BAFTA’s Best Film prize; Anora wins actress and casting
events.selectionReason: A rival’s breakthrough partly offset by Anora’s own wins.

events.title: Conclave wins the Screen Actors Guild ensemble prize
events.selectionReason: Late rival signal after Academy voting has already closed.

events.title: New York jury finds Trump guilty on 34 felony counts
events.selectionReason: Historic legal blow versus political mobilization.

events.title: Trump survives a shooting at his Pennsylvania rally
events.selectionReason: The campaign’s most widely recognized shocking moment.

events.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. suspends his campaign and endorses Trump
events.selectionReason: A rival joins forces rather than another debate or poll.

events.title: Harris and Trump meet in their first presidential debate
events.selectionReason: The replacement opponent’s national test.

events.title: Final Iowa Poll puts Harris ahead of Trump, 47% to 44%
events.selectionReason: A famous late surprise whose electoral conclusion proved wrong.

events.title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorses Zohran Mamdani
events.selectionReason: Nationally recognizable supporter and outsider momentum.

events.title: Cuomo concedes the Democratic primary to Mamdani
events.selectionReason: Primary victory is a development in the GENERAL election contract, not its resolving result.

events.title: Cuomo announces he will keep running for mayor as an independent
events.selectionReason: The beaten rival returns.

events.title: Mayor Eric Adams ends his re-election campaign
events.selectionReason: Incumbent exit changes the opposition field.

events.title: Governor Kathy Hochul endorses Mamdani
events.selectionReason: Party establishment joins the insurgent.
